scope: Owned header and full historical gift notice in CPU0805791C. Original kana password generation/format/alphabet and all three window geometries retained.

entries.review: Independent translation of the complete Japanese source. Preserve the congratulation, limited gift supply, every requested postcard field, highlighted password, complete postal recipient/address and refusal of phone/other inquiries. The original historical promotion is reproduced without claiming current availability. Kana code generation/alphabet is protocol data and remains unchanged; no personal data is collected by this build process.

source.japanese:
もっと不思議のダンジョンクリア
おめでとうございます！！
数に限りがございますが
記念品をプレゼントいたします。
ハガキに　あなたの
郵便番号・住所・名前・年齢
電話番号・{legacy-position:0306}パスワード{unclassified-control:05}
を　もれなくご記入のうえ
〒１６０－００２２
東京都新宿区新宿６－２４－２０
シグマ東新宿ビル１０Ｆ
㈱チュンソフト『トルネコ２アドバンス』係
まで　お送りください。
なお　お電話などでの
お問い合わせには　お答えできません。
ごりょうしょうください。

entries.english:
Congratulations on clearing More Magic Dungeon! We have a limited supply of commemorative gifts for you.

Please write all of the following on a postcard: your postal code, address, name, age, phone number and {color:6}password{/color}.

Send your postcard to:
Chunsoft Co., Ltd.
Attn: Torneko 2 Advance
10F Sigma Higashi-Shinjuku Bldg.

6-24-20 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku
Tokyo 160-0022, Japan

Please understand that we cannot answer inquiries by phone or other means.
